inner_sp: Each occupied inner s/p radial function uses its original six-primitive contraction.
inner_3d: Ga-Kr use only the original three-primitive d contraction, producing one core d radial function. The separate d1 is excluded from the fixed core.
polarization: The existing independent MACE polarization channel is unchanged.
scope: Period-1--4 main-group elements only; 26 supported templates, 25 elements in current 1000-system data.
note: This is a selected single-zeta NNAO core derived from 6-31G records, not the complete parent 6-31G contraction pattern. Numeric legacy core3/core6 interfaces retain their previous semantics outside this policy.
